solution:
The Correct answer is __**i - c, ii - d, iii - b, iv - a**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tuberculosis** (i) is a disease that primarily affects the **lungs** (c). It is caused by the bacterium **Mycobacterium tuberculosis** and mainly spreads through airborne droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes.
 
• **Hepatitis** (ii) is a condition that primarily affects the **liver** (d). It can be caused by various factors, including viral infections (Hepatitis A, B, C, D, and E), alcohol consumption, and autoimmune diseases.
